title: astragalus lentiginosus var. pseudiodanthus
intro: Astragalus lentiginosus var. pseudiodanthus, commonly known as little Utah milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote health and well-being. The plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic actions of reducing stress and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of little Utah milkvetch include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
